title: Review Wait on Member-Opened Exception Requests for Drugs that Need Prior Authorization (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Clause.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a review wait is added to the wait of a member who opens their own exception request, where the drug also needs prior authorization under the member's Utilization Management Program review package.

1. The drug is on the prior-authorization list of the member's review package, and no prior authorization for it is in force on the handling date. The package's standard decision hours divided by twenty-four are added.
2. The drug is on that list, and the prior authorization in force expires within the authorization renewal window of **30** days, that is, no more than 30 days after the handling date. The package's urgent decision hours divided by twenty-four are added.
3. In every other case, no review wait is added.

**In force.** The prior authorization read is the member's latest-expiring prior authorization for the drug. It is in force on the handling date when its expiration date is the handling date or later. When no authorization exists, or the latest one expired before the handling date, none is in force.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 1 June; package standard 72 hours, urgent 24 hours)

| Drug on the package's prior-authorization list | Latest authorization expires | Review wait |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none on record | 3 days (72 divided by 24) |
| yes | 31 May | 3 days, because it is no longer in force |
| yes | 1 July (30 days after) | 1 day (24 divided by 24) |
| yes | 2 July (31 days after) | none |
| no | any | none |

The review wait is added to the member's wait before the member's wait is compared with the days left.
